primary_source.document: BNY Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Press Release
cited_sections: Market and Wealth Services business segment highlights

definitions_and_limits: AUC/A means assets under custody and/or administration; it is not BNY proprietary investment capital or XRP exposure.
AUM is assets under management and must not be added to AUC/A as though the categories were disjoint.
The $630B securities-on-loan figure is for BNY's agency securities lending program, not digital-asset lending or XRP collateral.
BNY's collateral-management business scale does not establish that XRP is eligible collateral in BNY's current product set.

BNY's October 27 Ripple announcement separately confirms institutional XRP and RLUSD custody support; future RLUSD mint/redeem and tokenized trade-finance plans remain subject to approvals/client requirements.

research_implication.valid_use: Contextualize BNY's custody, securities-lending and collateral-management scale when evaluating the significance of its XRP/RLUSD custody announcement.
invalid_use: Do not infer XRP holdings from BNY AUC/A.
Do not infer XRP collateral acceptance from securities-on-loan totals.
Do not infer actual tokenized receivables volume or RLUSD settlement from announced exploration.
